proposal.name: Share and bound proposal evidence caching

plan.name: Share and bound proposal evidence caching
plan.summary: Complete issue #730 in one plumbing change by sharing proposal comparison and option preview lookup, atomic persistence, installation, restoration and eviction, while retaining their typed validators, native script-free renderers and distinct damage policies. Reuse a detached, complete input record keyed with its evidence kind and current validation/rendering contract, including all repository, issue, option, wording, source, choice, reader, comparison and diagnostic contents; unchanged inputs do no further validation, rendering or evidence writes, changed inputs miss, published identities still bind evidence and rendered bytes, healthy restoration builds and installs once without rewriting, and failed persistence remains retryable. Reclaim superseded proposal and preview pages, lookup entries and evidence files only after successful snapshot replacement or restart restoration, coordinating concurrent builds, HTTP readers and publication so all live repository, sibling and receipt references remain available and immutable URLs never change contents. Preserve receipt archive retry, whole-snapshot recovery, source-snapshot trust, factory marker-author checks, existing presentation bytes, URLs and ETags under the same format, and explicit obsolete-format diagnostics; update the two existing snapshot test helpers to publish through the real publication path and run the dashboard suites, affected formalize/statechart/verify rendering suites and dashboard race checks where available. Update SPEC.md, docs/dashboard.md and docs/statecharts.md to describe shared reuse, one-pass restoration and reachability retention with citations to D-0353, D-0355, D-0362 and D-0368; the merger records this cache refinement with the decision command because plumbing builds cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730RepeatedSnapshotsReuseWork
tests.says: Repeated authenticated snapshot assembly and publication reuse each complete comparison and preview without another validation/render pass or evidence write, preserving native HTML/SVG, URLs, ETags and detached returned presentations.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730ColdRestoreBuildsOnce
tests.says: A healthy cold restore builds each saved comparison and option once, installs that exact presentation without rewriting its file, and primes the same input lookup for subsequent refreshes.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730CompleteInputIdentity
tests.says: Changed source, include, view, reader, comparison, wording, choice, receipt, diagnostic, repository, issue or format misses even with retained statement hashes and fingerprints; identical detached records reuse work and never alter an old URL.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730RetriesFailedPersistence
tests.says: A failed evidence save leaves its validated page reusable but retries persistence on the next identical input, becoming write-free only after a successful atomic save.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730ConcurrentReuse
tests.says: Concurrent requests for identical comparison and preview records share one validation/render/save per entry while HTTP reads see complete, stable immutable bytes.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730PublicationReclaimsOnlySupersededPages
tests.says: Revisions and removed waiting items reclaim old memory, input lookup and disk records after publication, preserving other repositories, healthy options, receipts and concurrent HTTP readers; failed publication retains the current snapshot and its pages.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730RestartIsolatesDamageAndPrunes
tests.says: Missing, corrupt, mismatched and obsolete proposal/option records get isolated diagnostics, including when a matching input is already cached; successful restoration removes orphans, leaves healthy siblings unchanged and reuses durable diagnostics on the next restart.

tests.name: TestProposalCache730RejectedReceiptSnapshotDoesNotPrune
tests.says: Receipt damage still rejects the whole saved snapshot and keeps receipt retry recovery; no proposal or preview cleanup runs until a replacement snapshot is successfully published.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and acceptance tests, preserving the ratified contract except for the two requested test fixes. Check 1 passed: all eight tests fail against the unchanged base as required.
